paras: Ctenotus burbidgei, also known commonly as the plain-backed Kimberley ctenotus,  is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. It is endemic to Western Australia.
The specific name, burbidgei, is in honor of Australian zoologist Andrew A. Burbidge.
The preferred natural habitats of C. burbidgei are shrubland and savanna.
